instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\nozzle_seed.dxf. Import nozzle_seed.dxf. Draw a tapered nozzle side profile with vertices (0,20), (70,20), (130,40), (70,60), and (0,60). Add inlet circle centered at (0,40) radius 18, outlet circle centered at (130,40) radius 10, a CENTER line from (0,40) to (130,40), and text ACAD-30. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. [Software] Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.
